THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
BLUE & GOLD
031
40
Eyelet Blue
Wet-look dark brown hair swept
to one side with a single
loose strand across the face,
graphic liner on pale gray-green
eyes, glossy peach lips and a navy
high-neck knit with copper eyelets
and fine stitched line details. A soft
sky-blue gradient glows behind.
